name: noise-terrain-contours
prompt: Topographic map look: contour lines over fbm noise terrain, with lines that stay one pixel thick at any resolution.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote a topographic map shader: contour lines over fbm terrain on paper-colored ground, shaded from green lowlands to tan highlands. I haven't compiled or rendered it, because no live Powermove tools were attached to this run. The lines are measured in screen pixels, so they stay `uLineWidth` pixels thick (default 1) at any resolution, and every `uIndexEvery`-th line is drawn darker at the same thickness. Other controls set the scale, number of levels, drift speed, line opacity, tint strength, and paper, ink and tint colors.
